description: Canonical installed-hardware qualification cases. Every accepted firmware revision must pass all applicable mandatory cases against verified installed bytes.

cases.description: Browser assets/reset, actual CLI/input, Legacy/ExCom, display status/text, profile-specific output progress, fast SD round trip/cleanup and ordinary boot; startup never written.
8/20/8 without browser video, then profile-specific retained-video 8/20/8 or native HDMI 96/20/96 with text/DMA oracles; entry modes/Legacy route restored by suite lifecycle.

Prove RST 08h raw SD write effects on MBR-proven pre-partition sector 2, observe a per-run completion token after all raw I/O ends, then restore and verify the exact preimage through the independent C dispatch.

browser-video.automated_output_oracle: Three decoded WebSocket frames; 8/20/8 with browser absent and retained connection present.

native-hdmi.automated_output_oracle: Committed 8/20/8 modes, then 96/20/96 with fresh glyph/prompt and HDMI DMA progress, carrier and zero fault counters. No browser video requested. Physical pixels are not inferred from counters.
